note: Four GA rows. Three Chattahoochee NF campgrounds added; Cottonwood Patch excluded as a horse camp.

excluded.name: Cottonwood Patch Campground
excluded.why: agency: 'a multi-use campground focused primarily on equestrian camping, but welcomes traditional car camping'; sites are sized by horse trailers and it is gated. A horse camp that tolerates cars, not a general campground offering some horse sites. Also: RVs over 25 ft not recommended on the Georgia approach, trailers barred on the Tennessee one, and it floods
